label: Immanuel Kant, Critique of Pure Reason…: The cosmological proof’s use of contingent-to-cause…
locator: Ideal, section V, A609–610/B637–638; paragraph “The following fallacies” items 1–2
interpretation: Kant contests transcendental application and inference to a terminating first cause. This is an epistemic/semantic objection with Kantian grounds, not a proof that no extra-empirical cause exists. The local causal countermodel separately tests the need for added premises.
